Correct ONLY the background: replace the entire dark gradient background with one completely uniform flat solid RGB (0,255,0), hex #00ff00 bright chroma green. Every background pixel outside the twelve knights must be this same bright green, including gaps between their arms and bodies and between legs. No gradient, texture, shadow, glow, floor or vignette anywhere in the background. Keep all twelve painted knights unchanged: same ink and watercolor surface, same armour, helmet, heraldry, colors, silhouettes, exact pixel positions, sizes, limb angles and foot locations. Preserve all twelve distinct frames and their original 4-column 3-row layout and reading order. Hands stay empty, no weapons. No labels, borders or text. This is a background-color correction only; deliver the full same-size sheet.
